decisions.reason: Section K.3 (line 64) limits when either party’s defense and indemnification obligations apply and lists additional exclusions for Anthropic’s obligations on Customer Claims. It does not prohibit either party’s Use of an OriginalArtifact. The candidate’s Use/CONDITIONALLY_PROHIBITED representation turns an indemnity-coverage limitation into a use restriction, and no current same-license rule covers that indemnity allocation.

Section K.4 (line 65) sets out claim-handling procedures: prompt notice and reasonable cooperation by the indemnified party, defense control by the indemnifying party, a limited settlement-rejection right, and an excuse for material prejudice from specified failures. These are operative indemnity-claim duties, not a permitted activity involving an OriginalArtifact; the candidate’s Use representation does not faithfully encode them. No current same-license rule covers this process.

Section K.5 (line 66) makes indemnification the sole and exclusive remedy under the Terms only to the extent a third-party claim is covered by Section K. This is a limitation on remedies, not permission to Use an OriginalArtifact or a duty governing a permitted activity. No current same-license rule covers it.
